news.headline: Traders on Kalshi now think it's likely that the S&P 500 will hit 8,000 in 2026
news.summary: Kalshi traders are pricing in a solid chance the S&P 500 reaches 8,000 next year, buoyed by this week's 5%+ rally that pushed the index to fresh records. The prediction market signal reflects growing confidence in continued upside momentum.

news.headline: Warner Bros. Discovery reports 10% jump in streaming revenue ahead of proposed Paramount combination
news.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery's streaming business hit $3B in Q2 revenue, up 10% year-over-year—a key metric as the company pursues its proposed combination with Paramount. The growth underscores the competitive streaming landscape and WBD's push to scale its direct-to-consumer offerings.

educational.title: What Is Bitcoin's 'Halving' and Why Does It Matter?
points: Roughly every 4 years, Bitcoin's mining reward is cut in half by design
This slows how fast new bitcoin enters circulation, capping supply growth
It's baked into the code — no company or person decides when it happens
Historically, halvings have preceded major price cycles, though it's not guaranteed
The last coin will ever be mined around the year 2140 due to this schedule
